parameters.content:
## Participant Sync (run on demand)

Pulls every patient from Cliniko (paginated), detects NDIS plan management type from the patient's text fields (plan-managed / self-managed / NDIA), and upserts them into ndis_participants keyed by Cliniko patient id — safe to re-run any time; existing rows are updated, not duplicated.

Test records get synthetic NDIS numbers (43 + reference number digits) and plan dates 2026-01-01 → 2027-12-31. With real patients, fill true NDIS numbers and plan dates in the data table — this sync fills the structure, the clinic owns the truth.
